Range("H1").ClearContents
For i = 1 To 3
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, i * 25, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio" & CStr(i)
Next i
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$1"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.Value = 1
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").Delete
Report = CStr(Range("H1").Value) & "|"
For Each sh In ActiveSheet.Shapes
If Left(sh.Name, 5) = "Radio" Then
Report = Report & sh.Name & ":" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.Value) & ":" & sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell & ";"
End If
Next sh
